# Research

Before writing a note, verify what the note will be built on.

## Flow

1. Build a content-type-aware query: append the right lens — `tradeoffs
   comparison` (conceptual), `algorithm explanation time complexity`
   (algorithmic), `python documentation tutorial` (hands-on-code),
   `reference documentation syntax` (reference) — plus the current year,
   plus the topic.
2. Search for the subtopic title itself (not the whole roadmap).
3. Extract into the draft only what was FOUND: exact API signatures, current
   package names, real error messages, honest definitions. Note anything the
   search couldn't verify so the draft can say so instead of guessing.

## Rules

- Never fabricate a source, a benchmark, or a syntax that the research
  didn't return.
- Two solid results beat five shallow ones.
- If the search is empty, write from established knowledge and flag the
  unverified claims with a `> ⚠️ verify` note rather than asserting them.
